description: This file contains test code for OpenSSL's cipher implementations, including vector tests, CAVP tests, Wycheproof tests, and utility functions for cipher operations.

methods.name: GetCipher
methods.description: Returns an EVP_CIPHER pointer based on the cipher name string.

methods.name: OperationToString
methods.description: Converts an Operation enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: MaybeCopyCipherContext
methods.description: Copies an EVP_CIPHER_CTX if requested, to allow safe reuse.

methods.name: TestCipherAPI
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption tests using EVP_CIPHER API with various parameters.

methods.name: TestLowLevelAPI
methods.description: Tests low-level AES encryption APIs (CTR, CBC, OFB) with different chunk sizes.

methods.name: TestCipher
methods.description: Runs comprehensive cipher tests over multiple configurations and modes.

methods.name: CipherFileTest
methods.description: Runs cipher tests based on external test vector files.
